name: Szadek
title: Lord of Secrets
summary: The hidden guildmaster whose manipulation of the Decamillennial crisis shattered the ancient Guildpact.
biography: Szadek was the elusive founder of House Dimir, the guild that cultivated secrecy and misinformation across Ravnica.
During the Decamillennial crisis, his machinations led Agrus Kos to discover and arrest him, triggering the Guildpact's collapse.

featuredCard.name: Szadek, Lord of Secrets
featuredCard.significance: The original depiction of Ravnica's hidden Dimir founder.

source.title: Wizards — A Flavorful Guide to the Guilds of Ravnica
